oneSentenceStory: Calmly review your accumulated rewards and protect expiring points without artificial urgency to keep your retirement and future goals on track.
customerSituation: Elena has accumulated 24,500 LBG Coins across multiple long-term savings goals but has experienced a 34-day inactivity period while 2,400 points approach expiration.
storyTension: A risk of value loss from expiring points threatens an otherwise disciplined and robust long-term accumulation strategy.
customerResolution: Transparent, educational guidance highlights expiring points calmly and shows how to secure them toward her primary Retirement Fund goal.
primaryOutcome: Re-engage with long-term savings journey through clear, educational value transparency.
completionSignals: Customer engages with projected-value education component
Expiring points notification is viewed in a calm context
